cohort: 26 infants with myelomeningocele admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit between 2001 and 2015
finding: Perinatal complications and ambulation status at 2 years of age were not significantly different between infants born by vaginal delivery and those born by elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Perinatal complications and ambulation status at 2 years of age were not significantly different between infants born by vaginal delivery and those born by elective cesarean section.
